status: AUDIT COMPLETE — READY FOR STAGE 2 APPROVAL
scope_boundary_note: READ-ONLY AUDIT. NO MODEL RETRAINING OR EARTH ENGINE MUTATION PERFORMED.

phenological_windows.early: 0% to 25% of growing season duration (emergence / early vegetative)
phenological_windows.mid: 25% to 75% of growing season duration (peak growth / flowering)
phenological_windows.late: 75% to 100% of growing season duration (maturation / senescence)
phenological_windows.full: 0% to 100% of growing season duration (entire season composite)

item_03_geometry_descriptors.distinction_note: Parcel geometry descriptors measure macro parcel polygon boundary shape, NOT raster pixel-level canopy texture.

item_04_raster_pixel_availability.status: NO LOCAL RASTER ARRAYS OR GEOTIFF PATCHES EXIST ON DISK.
item_04_raster_pixel_availability.extraction_history: All prior phases (Phase 6C, 6D, 6E) executed GEE server-side reduceRegion() aggregations, saving only tabular scalar band means and stds to CSV.
item_04_raster_pixel_availability.operational_requirement: GLCM texture computation requires querying Google Earth Engine server-side via image.glcmTexture() or extracting pixel arrays.

candidate_bands.rationale: Primary choice; NIR canopy reflection captures foliage density, canopy gaps, and row spacing without 20m coarse-pixel artifacts.
Secondary choice; Red band sensitive to soil-vegetation contrast and bare soil patches.

item_05_candidate_glcm_parameters.exclusion_rationale: 20m native resolution is too coarse for Telangana smallholders; single pixel (400 m2) exceeds 5.86% of farms.
item_05_candidate_glcm_parameters.quantization: 32 gray levels (linear scaling of 0-10000 surface reflectance into [0, 31])
item_05_candidate_glcm_parameters.directions: 4 standard directions (0, 45, 90, 135 deg) directionally averaged (omnidirectional isotropic)
item_05_candidate_glcm_parameters.polygon_aggregation: Zonal mean (ee.Reducer.mean()) over farm parcel polygon

item_06_label_independence.proof: GLCM computation operates strictly on satellite reflectance arrays and vector parcel geometries. Crop labels (Crop, category) are never passed to the extractor.

option_a_gee_server_side.estimated_runtime: 2 - 3 hours for full cohort (resumable chunks with ThreadPoolExecutor)
option_a_gee_server_side.failure_risk: Low (handles cloudy/empty windows natively via masked reducers)

option_b_local_raster_download.method: Download 31,552 image patches via GEE REST API + skimage.feature.graycomatrix
option_b_local_raster_download.estimated_runtime: 8 - 15 hours + high risk of GEE 429 quota exhaustion
option_b_local_raster_download.failure_risk: High (network latency, quota exhaustion, disk I/O)

item_09_cohort_and_spatial_cv_preservati.guarantee: All 7 ablation experiments will use the exact same 7,843 farms and the identical 5 folds.

S (Spectral).description: 20 full-season raw band stats (B2-B12 mean & std) + 14 full-season spectral indices (ndvi, evi, etc.). Identical to Phase 6F Exp A.

T (Temporal).description: Multi-window spectral features across early, mid, late (102 features) + 4 temporal trajectory deltas. (S + T = 140 features, identical to Phase 6F Exp C).

P (Spatial Texture).description: 5 GLCM texture metrics (contrast, dissimilarity, homogeneity, energy, correlation) computed on B8 across 4 phenological windows (5 x 4 = 20 features).

item_10_proposed_schema_and_experiment_m.common_classifier: XGBoost (Trial 4 regularized parameters: depth=7, lr=0.05, colsample=0.75, subsample=0.80, reg_lambda=5.0)
